title: AITA for planning to ask my bf to stop hanging out with his best friend?
question: AITA for planning to ask my bf to stop hanging out with his best friend?
body: Our relationship is really healthy although this petition i plan to make. we both are very respectful to each other. He smokes weed frequently with his best friend but now he is into cocaine. And I'm ok with weed but not with cocaine. He is his only close friend. AITA?
